result.summary: Found 1 major content issue: an untranslated localization key is being rendered as plain text instead of the intended section title.

issues.description: The section title 'home_feed.popular_title' is displaying a raw localization/i18n key instead of the actual translated text (e.g., 'Popular near you'). This indicates a missing or failed string translation lookup.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' is properly defined in all supported language files, and add a fallback string so that even if the key is missing, a human-readable default is shown instead of the raw key.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal scroll list has its name cut off ('Trattoria Piccol...'), with no visual indicator (e.g., ellipsis) that the text is truncated.
issues.suggestion: Apply CSS text-overflow: ellipsis or limit the card width consistently so truncation is visually communicated to the user.
